from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfit(BaseModel):
    """The total profit reported for one company's financial period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    total_profit: float | None = Field(description="The total profit (利润总额) value in yuan")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the profit figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profits: list[CompanyProfit]
